title: Which is better for a 20$ plan? Codex or Claude?
author: ziadd_hh
selftext:
i want to start making mobile games in Godot, game assets are ready but i need the logic and coding agent for the game to function.

i can only afford either the Codex Plus (20$) or Claude Pro (20$). which one could handle more jobs before hitting the limits fast and actually do good work (since its only for coding)?

anyone tested these plans and have tips for me?

comments.author: redditscraperbot2
comments.body: Claude is way more permissive. I think sol 6.1 bridges that gap, but for game work I'd trust opus to do a better job.

replies.author: ziadd_hh
replies.body: i didnt know about these changes

replies.author: redditscraperbot2
replies.body: It's not a set rule. I'd just keep you subscription open to change because it always does.

comments.author: CashewSwagger
comments.body:
I have the 20$ on both. Personally I prefer Claude. 

Gpt6 both Sol and Astra are very good but you dont get much mileage comparatively. 

Ive gotten a lot from my Claude sub. Especially if you are smart about model usage.

replies.author: ziadd_hh
replies.body: i just dont want to hit the limit while the agent didnt even finish anything, people on YT use the 200$ plan and say that they hit the limit within couple of prompts.

replies.author: CashewSwagger
replies.body:
It really really depends on what you are doing. I'm working on a tabletop game companion web app for my gaming group and yeah I can burn through my weekly in a few days if I am non stop with it. But then again the app is more or less a player controlled RPG using typescript/java/Pixi. Much of the usage was asset gen. 

All in all your results may vary. I can have sonnet 5.5 on high and till away at spell details and combat mechanics all week no issue.

replies.author: ziadd_hh
replies.body: well the first idea i wanted to create is a racing motorcycle game. i have the models and UI ready but i just dont know how to code the motorcycle physics or even make the playerbody adapt to motion and animations. thats why i need the AI. what do you think?

replies.author: CashewSwagger
replies.body:
Oh yeah if its just code work 100% Claude. 

Are you using an engine like Godot or Unity? I got tons of mileage from Claude and godot.

replies.author: ziadd_hh
replies.body: i wanted at first to use Unity because i have past experience with it but its so big in size and complex while its still easy to use for me. but if im going to use AI i would definitely do it with godot. simple and small and not too big like unity which i think it helps the AI to not use much more tokens. idk if this is true or not im just guessing :D

comments.author: M4xs0n
comments.body: Claude is better for visual stuff. Codex 6.1 SOL for cheap and impressive coding tasks

replies.author: ziadd_hh
replies.body: i have the UI, scenes and models ready. you recommend gpt6 sol for coding and make the game function? is it cheaper this way or should i try claude instead?

comments.author: Torschlusspaniker
comments.body:
I have both and recently I burn through codex very fast. 

Claude I can go for multiple sessions and better results for 3d work

replies.author: Torschlusspaniker
replies.body: Yes , pretty proactive about managing context and I just get more out of Claude. A while back the reverse was true

replies.author: geddy
replies.body: I learned about context too late, now I always clear it each time I start something new. I used to just use the same one prompt and keep working lol, ate up my tokens fast.

comments.author: AsparagusOk8818
comments.body:
I'm happy with my Codex subscription and, frankly, I don't trust Anthropic at the moment (...not that OpenAI is great either). 

People are clearly having a lot of success with Claude, but I'll stand up and represent my Astra and Sol agents here. They've done fine work for me on every level and I like OpenAI's desktop app.

replies.author: AsparagusOk8818
replies.body: Yes. I'm a broke boy; cannot afford anything beyond the cheapest plan.

comments.author: taisui
comments.body: Claude, but Astra makes better assets.

comments.author: d954mas
comments.body: Take codex, it can generate images and fakeshots

replies.author: ziadd_hh
replies.body: but claude also generate UI for games, how is that possible since it does not create images?

replies.author: d954mas
replies.body: Claude can't make fakeshots, can't make complex icons. Claude can make svg, or images with code. Codex can generate any image
